# Hypercolor 0.8.1

The Python client now accepts layouts without canvas dimensions. This fixes Home Assistant snapshot loading against daemons using the new layout schema.

## Layouts and previews

Canvas resolution comes from daemon settings. Saved layouts retain normalized geometry, and loading an older layout no longer overrides the configured resolution. The layout API and generated Python models follow the same contract.

Preview delivery preserves fractional source cadence and publishes state before notifying viewers. Retargeting a preview to an absent zone withdraws the previous frame. The web UI sizes effect previews to the visible box and releases compositor layers after entrance animations.

## Portable HTML effects

Imported HTML bundles retain their manifest identity across installations, including bundles with nested entrypoints. Supporting HTML files stay out of the effect catalog, and duplicate bundle identities are rejected.

## Upgrade notes

Update Python clients to 0.8.1 when using the dimension-free layout API. Home Assistant integrations must require `hypercolor>=0.8.1,<0.9.0` to replace an already installed 0.8.0 client. Existing integration settings and entity identities do not need to be recreated.

Clients that create or edit layouts should configure canvas resolution through daemon settings instead of layout fields.
